text: How are the trainer's murder and the favourite's disappearance connected? — the horse broke loose in the struggle and was taken up later by someone else
id: q.connection=the horse broke loose in the struggle and was taken up later by someone else
why: The story has raised the link between the struggle and the missing horse: the horse's tracks are in the mud where the trainer died, and the police theory (¶46) says the horse may have bolted during the struggle. Someone else taking the horse was also raised as a possibility (the gypsies, ¶62).

text: Which way did the horse go from the hollow? — loose across the moor, alone
why: The story has just shown a man's track beside the horse's (¶119), so the answer 'alone' is contradicted by the text so far. Holmes's 'alone' idea was also set aside as unlikely, not confirmed.
